results.headline: Zelensky faces street protests and calls to sack top general after firing defence minister
results.reason: why_it_matters: claims it was 'Fedorov's ousted deputy' who publicly accused General Syrskiy of blocking military reforms, but the cited source A579 states it was the outgoing defense minister himself (Fedorov) who made that accusation ('Ukraine's outgoing defense minister blamed Oleksandr Syrskiy for hindering military reforms'), and the story's own reporting_varies section attributes the clash directly to 'ousted defence minister Fedorov and General Syrskiy' -- not a deputy. This is an unsupported/contradicted attribution.

results.headline: Andy Burnham takes office as UK's seventh prime minister in a decade
results.reason: summary: states Burnham replaced Starmer 'after barely two years in office,' but no cited source specifies Starmer's tenure length -- cited sources only establish Burnham is the 'seventh since 2016' / 'seventh leader in a decade,' which does not establish a specific ~2-year duration for Starmer. This is an unsupported specific duration.
